Priya Kapoor: Hey team :wave: I need to swap my Fri 18:00 -> Mon 06:00 oncall (bank holiday plans). Can anyone cover Fri night -> Sat morning? I can take Sat evening -> Mon morning if someone can take the first half.

Ethan Cole: @Priya I can take Fri 18:00 -> Sat 06:00. Quick Q: any scheduled jobs or canaries while I'm on?

Priya Kapoor: Thanks @Ethan! Two things to note: 1) Weekly model batch runs Sat 02:00 (heavy GPU use) — avoid rolling models around that time. 2) Infra scheduled a soft maintenance window Sat 03:30-04:30 that might be pushed. Runbook snippet for prewarm/cache below.

```
# prewarm cache (fills KV caches + warm kernels)
./scripts/prewarm.sh --model rwd-xl --workers 4
# list inference cronjobs
kubectl get cronjobs -n inference
# quick check for model rollout status
kubectl rollout status deployment/model-service -n inference
```

Liu Zhang: If @Ethan is only until Sat 06:00 I can pick Sat 06:00 -> Sat 22:00. I can also stay proxied during the 02:00 batch if you want extra eyes.

Marta Rivera: Heads up — a canary rollout for v1.14 is scheduled Fri 22:00 in staging and may promote to prod ~23:30. If it does, watch the latency dashboards and bump prewarm by +2 workers. I'll be reachable by DM.

Priya Kapoor: Updated the calendar and added the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-weekend. I've set the promotion to manual so you can veto prod promotion if it's noisy.

oncall-bot: Shift update: Ethan Cole assigned Fri 18:00 -> Sat 06:00; Liu Zhang assigned Sat 06:00 -> Sat 22:00; Priya Kapoor will take Sat 22:00 -> Mon 06:00. (Generated at 2026-03-18T10:17:30Z)

Ethan Cole: Got it. I'll avoid any model rolls at 02:00. Quick Q: what's the fastest rollback for the model service if latency spikes?

Priya Kapoor: Fast rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-service -n inference` then `kubectl rollout status` to confirm. Full rollback/runbook is on the link. Also keep #incidents and #eng-oncall pinned for alerts.

Marta Rivera: :thumbsup: Thanks all. @Ethan DM me if you want me to shadow the 02:00 batch. GL and enjoy the long weekend, Priya!
